english.note: Use this for an employment post or official job position rather than a general location.

exampleSentences.english: I want to apply for this position.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 san1 cing2 ni1 go3 zik1 wai6

english.note: Use this for an appointed job or position in an organisation.

exampleSentences.traditional: 呢個職位要識講流利英文。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 go3 zik1 wai6 jiu3 sik1 gong2 lau4 lei6 jing1 man4

english.note: Use this for the office or position that the person has been appointed to hold.

exampleSentences.english: The manager's appointment was vacant for six months, but someone has finally taken the position.
exampleSentences.traditional: 經理呢個職位空缺咗半年，終於有人接手。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ging1 lei5 ni1 go3 zik1 wai6 hung1 kyut3 zo2 bun3 nin4 zung1 jyu1 jau5 jan4 zip3 sau2

english.note: Use 職位 when an assignment means an official post or position someone is sent to fill.

exampleSentences.english: Their overseas assignment is a very important position.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢今次外派嘅職位幾重要。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 gam1 ci3 ngoi6 paai3 ge3 zik1 wai6 gei2 zung6 jiu3
